Docile enough to farm, and its milk is prized despite - or because of - how little the animal itself resembles anything back home. Body bulk is identical in every facing: the broad armored barrel body keeps the same width and the same height from front, side and rear. The rear view, seen from behind, shows the same broad low barrel as the front view, filling the same width, with the plated back spread wide across the frame, the three pairs of thick legs splayed outward to the same stance width as in the front view, the haunches and the curled horn tips visible, and the face and eyes hidden. Realistic painterly vanilla RimWorld sprite style, soft painted edges in a deeper shade of the local colour. Exactly ONE creature, centred, the whole body visible with nothing cut off. observed.facings.png: Three facings at one shared scale on a checkerboard. All three show the same massive, shaggy, cream-coloured quadruped at about the same height. South is a front view: a lowered head with two short horns between drooping lop ears and two long tusks hanging down. East is a full side profile with a high shoulder hump, a heavy head with two forward horns and long down-curving tusks, a short tail and dark split hooves. North is a rear view: haunches and a hanging tail, with the ear edges and horn tips just showing above the shoulders. There is no face on the north view.
observed.south.png: Front view, face toward the camera. A heavy, broad head with half-closed eyes and a bovine muzzle. Two short pointed horns rise from the nose bridge or forehead. Long pinkish-lined ears droop down both sides. Two long ivory tusks curve down past the chest. The body is a wall of long cream fur, and four legs end in dark cloven hooves. The background is clean transparent with no shadow. Painterly fur rendering.
observed.east.png: Right-facing side profile. A massive body with a strong dorsal hump over the shoulders, long shaggy cream fur over the whole body, and a darker tan face. There are two short dark horns on the upper snout and forehead, a long drooping ear, and two long tusks curving down and slightly forward. It has a short tufted tail and thick legs with dark split hooves. Clean alpha. Painterly and realistic.
observed.north.png: Rear view: rump, a long hanging fur-covered tail and four legs with hooves. The ear tips stick out at the sides and two small horn tips show at the top. No face or eyes. Clean alpha.
observed.scale.png: At max zoom the animal fills about 3.5 cells and stands far taller and longer than the vanilla human. At 32 px per cell it reads clearly as a big pale shaggy beast with visible tusks, separate from the brown ground.
